worst_problem: Key story gestures and contacts explicitly required by the brief and subtitles are completely missing—Lalla Aïcha never taps her cheek (b145), smiles with an uncovered face when the text says she buries her face in her hands (b147), never touches Zoubida's hand (b148), and in the final embrace (b151) both women stand far apart clutching empty air while the boy never turns to watch.
